title: Glatzencraft
description: The official modpack for the Glatzencraft community server – featuring Create and Refined Storage
body:
This is the official Glatzencraft modpack. It features:

* [Create Fly](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fly) – a tech mod based around kinetic energy
* [Refined Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/refined-storage) – a way to store your items on a disk, removing the hassle of having to sort chests
* [Fabric Simple Generator](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-simple-generator) – as a way to generate energy for Refined Storage
* [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated) and [More Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-delight) for more food
* [End Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/endrem) – overhauling the way to the end by requiring 12 different ender eyes, each obtained a different way
* [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy) and [Voxy Server](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxyserver) – to allow higher view distances
* [Lootr](https://modrinth.com/mod/lootr) – to allow for everyone to get their fair share of loot, especially in end ships
* [Vanilla Structure Update](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanilla-structure-update) – overhauling many vanilla structures to be more interesting
* [Gamma Utils](https://modrinth.com/mod/gamma-utils) – to allow for better vision in the dark
* [Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) – to keep track of all the new crafting recipes
* [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat) – to allow speaking to others on the server
* many performance optimization mods like [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [Async](https://modrinth.com/mod/async), [ScalableLux](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux), [C2ME](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric) and many more
* many QoL mods, including but not limited to many of [LunaPixelStudios' mods](https://modrinth.com/user/LunaPixelStudios/mods)
* anti-cheat mods like [AntiXray](https://modrinth.com/mod/anti-xray)
* and many more
